'''Nil-Uu''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] who lived during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. At some point after the conquest, Nil-Uu went to the [[Shrine of Silence]] but she fell victim to the power of the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as [[The Curse]]. Nil-Uu was later killed by the [[Alliance Commander]] when they themselves went to kill the Curse.<ref name="TOR:SoS"/>
